# Cost of Quality Summary Report — Ellison Hydraulics (fictional), 2026

*Generated by `python tools/coqkit.py report` from the course data.*

## Headline

- Total booked cost of quality: **$2,852,930** = **7.08% of sales**.
- Monthly CoQ fell from **$249,230** (months 1–6) to **$209,790** (months 10–12): 7.53% → 6.07% of sales; annualized saving **$473,280**.
- Hidden failure costs are estimated at **$1,049,000/yr** — 0.5× the booked failure cost (estimate; wide uncertainty).

## Notes

- Booked costs come from the ledger (`data/coq_ledger.csv`); hidden costs are estimates and are reported separately.
- Savings in failure categories are partly offset by higher prevention spending; the net figures above include that.
